UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents an authenticated user profile in TrustSentry.

userId.description: Unique user ID matching Firebase Auth UID.

displayName.description: User display name from Google Sign-In.

VerificationRecord.title: VerificationRecord
VerificationRecord.description: Cryptographic artifact verification event logged by user.

artifactType.description: Standard type (e.g. W3C VC, TS1, GS1 Link).

issuer.description: Entity or DID authority that issued the artifact.

status.description: Verdict status (TRUSTED, REVIEW, SUSPICIOUS, INVALID, UNABLE_TO_VERIFY).

riskLevel.description: Calculated risk level (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL).

isPinned.description: Whether artifact is pinned in user vault.

ChatSession.title: ChatSession
ChatSession.description: Multi-turn Gemini AI advisory chat session.

title.description: Title or topic of the AI advisory conversation.

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: Individual message in Gemini chat thread.

content.description: Markdown or text content of the message.

model.description: Gemini model that generated the response if role is model.

groundedSources.description: JSON string of Google Search citations if grounded.

/users/{userId}.description: User profile collection isolated per authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/verifications/{verificat.description: Cloud persistent verification audit trail for user.

/users/{userId}/chats/{chatId}.description: AI advisory chat conversations for user.

/users/{userId}/chats/{chatId}/messages/.description: Messages belonging to an AI chat conversation.
